homelab.title: What runs at home
homelab.intro: A Raspberry Pi 5 works as media server, ad blocker, library and test bench. Everything in containers, brought up from a single Docker Compose file.

services.docker: Each service in its own container, one file brings everything up.
services.jellyfin: Films and series on any screen in the house.
services.arr: Find and organise the content so Jellyfin picks it up sorted.
services.pihole: Local DNS that blocks ads and trackers for the whole network.
services.gamefinder: A game finder written from scratch.
services.agent: PowerShell agent for the Windows machine.
services.ollama: Language models running locally. FitDash and CineStream use it.

hero.title: I run systems and build the Python applications that run on them.
hero.description: FastAPI backends, React interfaces, PostgreSQL, Docker and local language models. From the infrastructure to the screen, no hand-offs.
hero.availability: Santa Cruz de Tenerife. Open to remote roles worldwide and on-site roles in Spain and Europe.

about.title: About
about.paragraph: I work as a systems administrator and build complete Python applications: the API, the React frontend, the database and the server they are deployed on. Coming from operations means I think about how each piece will be run before I write it.
